name: world_cities
label: World city and capital names
provenance: Merged during the 2026-07-24 consolidation from two independently built city lists (671 names on claude/scope-vs-please-yrlsll and 1,323 on claude/next-task-tnbsmq, roughly 45 percent overlap) via case-insensitive dedupe plus an alphabetical sort. STATUS.md records the cost of that merge: only the names survived, the original curation order and rationale of both source files did not, and the 1,323-name list had itself already had 326 raw duplicate lines removed post hoc. Real city and capital names, not verified against a gazetteer. 93 of 1,691 lines fail the character rule and are grandfathered in scripts/check_data.py - mostly accented Latin (Araxa/Araxá, Acores/Açores) and 5 periods, but also one U+00AD SOFT HYPHEN, which is invisible in an editor. None of these characters are in the current (stale) data/shared_vocab.json, so these 93 names are already being altered silently at encode time.
